{"parse":{"title":"Billboard Year-End Hot 100 singles of 2007","pageid":14830368,"redirects":[],"wikitext":"{{Short description|Ranking of recorded music}}\n\nThis is a list of ''[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]'' magazine's Top '''[[Billboard Hot 100|Hot 100]]''' songs of 2007.<ref>[http://www.billboard.com/charts/year-end/2007/hot-100-songs 2007 Year-End Hot 100 Songs]</ref>\n[[File:Beyonce concert Barcelona.jpg|thumb|right|px|[[Beyoncé Knowles|Beyoncé]] topped the chart with her song \"[[Irreplaceable]]\" and reached number 62 with \"[[Beautiful Liar]],\" a collaboration with [[Shakira]].]]\n[[File:Rihannalive2007.jpg|thumb|right|px|Barbadian singer [[Rihanna]] had three songs on the chart, [[Umbrella (song)|Umbrella]]\" at position 2 and  \"[[Shut Up and Drive (Rihanna song)|Shut Up and Drive]]\" at position 90 from her album ''[[Good Girl Gone Bad]]'', and  \"[[Break It Off]]\" at position 85 from her album ''[[A Girl Like Me (Rihanna album)|A Girl Like Me]].'']]\n[[File:Akon 2008.jpg|thumb|right|px|[[Akon]] lent his vocals to six songs on the chart, four of which are in the top twenty.]]\n[[File:Fergie 2007.jpg|thumb|right|px|American pop singer [[Fergie (singer)|Fergie]] had three songs on the chart, all in the top twenty. \"[[Big Girls Don't Cry (Fergie song)|Big Girls Don't Cry]]\" at 4, \"[[Glamorous (Fergie song)|Glamorous]]\" at 10, and  \"[[Fergalicious]]\" at 19.]]\n[[File:PlainWhiteTs.jpg|thumb|right|px|[[Plain White T's|The Plain White T's]] had the most successful song on the chart by any band with  \"[[Hey There Delilah]]\" at position 7.]]\n[[File:Justin Timberlake.jpg|thumb|right|px|Pop singer [[Justin Timberlake]] had the most songs on the chart, with seven.]]\n{| class=\"wikitable sortable\" style=\"text-align: center\"\n|-\n!
